name: glb-designer-stage9b
description: Asset Studio Stage 9b — component building blocks. (1) Selective extraction: build a slab 'top' box, then decompose-pick JUST the 4 legs of the built-in 'dining-chair' and insert them alongside → assert 4 legs + 1 box (5 parts), screenshot the frankenstein table. (2) User components: group the legs + save as 'My leg', place it via arm→click-to-place (assert a fresh group landed), then delete the component through the confirm flow (assert it's gone).

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setUserComponents?.([]); })()

steps.name: set-slab-top
steps.comment: Seed the design with a single slab 'top' box (the table top) via the setSpec seam.
steps.eval: (function(){ window.__glbDesigner.setSpec({ sourceScale: 1, meshOverrides: {}, parts: [{ id: 'top', kind: 'box', position: [0, 0.42, 0], size: [1.0, 0.05, 0.6], color: '#8a6a42' }] }); return undefined; })()

waitFor.store: (() => { const s = window.__glbDesigner.getSpec(); return s.parts.length === 1 && s.parts[0].id === 'top'; })()

steps.name: preview-decompose-chair
steps.comment: Kick off previewDecompose('dining-chair'); stash the resolved metadata on window (don't RETURN the promise — a multi-RAF offscreen decompose can outlive the CDP round-trip, like 9a).

steps.name: wait-preview
steps.failMessage: previewDecompose('dining-chair') never resolved — offscreen procedural decompose may not work headlessly

steps.name: pick-legs-and-insert
steps.comment: The legs are the 4 decomposed parts with the lowest bbox-centre Y (they sit under the seat/back). Select just those + insert them alongside the slab; the chair's single group is only partially chosen so it drops and the 4 legs land as loose parts. Uses the explicit-ids insert seam so the subset is deterministic.
steps.eval: (function(){ const pv = window.__nineB.preview; console.log('9B_PREVIEW entries=' + pv.entries.length + ' partCount=' + pv.parts.length); const byY = pv.parts.slice().sort((a, b) => a.position[1] - b.position[1]); const legs = byY.slice(0, 4).map(p => p.id); window.__nineB.pickedLegIds = legs; console.log('9B_PICK legs=' + JSON.stringify(legs)); window.__glbDesigner.insertSelectedParts(legs); console.log('9B_AFTER_INSERT parts=' + window.__glbDesigner.getSpec().parts.length); return undefined; })()

steps.name: wait-inserted
steps.failMessage: insert of the 4 legs alongside the box did not reach 5 parts

steps.name: assert-legs-plus-box
steps.comment: Frankenstein table = 1 slab box + 4 inserted legs (loose, no group). The original chair leg ids must NOT leak into the live spec (fresh ids).
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__glbDesigner.getSpec(); const boxes = s.parts.filter(p => p.id === 'top'); const others = s.parts.filter(p => p.id !== 'top'); if (s.parts.length !== 5) throw new Error('expected 5 parts, got ' + s.parts.length); if (boxes.length !== 1) throw new Error('expected 1 box top, got ' + boxes.length); if (others.length !== 4) throw new Error('expected 4 legs, got ' + others.length); for (const id of window.__nineB.pickedLegIds) { if (s.parts.some(p => p.id === id)) throw new Error('decompose id leaked into live spec: ' + id); } console.log('9B_INSERT parts=' + s.parts.length + ' legs=' + others.length + ' box=' + boxes.length); })()

steps.name: render-frankenstein
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = window.__glbDesignerThree; if (t) t.gl.render(t.scene, t.camera); })()

steps.name: render-frankenstein-2
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = window.__glbDesignerThree; if (t) t.gl.render(t.scene, t.camera); })()

steps.name: group-legs
steps.comment: Wrap the 4 loose legs in one transform group named 'My leg' so it can be saved as a component (Save-as-component operates on a group).
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(window.__glbDesigner.getSpec())); const legIds = s.parts.filter(p => p.id !== 'top').map(p => p.id); s.partGroups = [{ id: 'pg-scenario-legs', name: 'My leg', partIds: legIds }]; window.__glbDesigner.setSpec(s); return undefined; })()

steps.name: save-as-component
steps.eval: (function(){ const ok = window.__glbDesigner.saveGroupAsComponent('pg-scenario-legs'); if (!ok) throw new Error('saveGroupAsComponent returned false'); const list = window.__glbDesigner.listUserComponents(); if (list.length !== 1) throw new Error('expected 1 user component, got ' + list.length); if (list[0].name !== 'My leg') throw new Error('component name mismatch: ' + list[0].name); window.__nineB.componentId = list[0].id; console.log('9B_SAVE components=' + list.length + ' name=' + list[0].name); })()

steps.name: arm-and-place-component
steps.comment: Arm the saved component (same handler the panel button calls) then place it via the face-click seam — a fresh group of 4 leg clones lands at the clicked point.

steps.name: wait-placed
steps.failMessage: placing the user component did not add a new group

steps.name: assert-placed-group
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__glbDesigner.getSpec(); const groups = s.partGroups || []; if (groups.length !== window.__nineB.groupsBefore + 1) throw new Error('expected ' + (window.__nineB.groupsBefore + 1) + ' groups, got ' + groups.length); const placed = groups.find(g => g.id !== 'pg-scenario-legs' && g.name === 'My leg'); if (!placed) throw new Error('placed group not found'); if (placed.partIds.length !== 4) throw new Error('expected 4 parts in placed group, got ' + placed.partIds.length); console.log('9B_PLACE groups=' + groups.length + ' placedParts=' + placed.partIds.length); })()

steps.name: render-placed
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = window.__glbDesignerThree; if (t) t.gl.render(t.scene, t.camera); })()

steps.name: render-placed-2
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = window.__glbDesignerThree; if (t) t.gl.render(t.scene, t.camera); })()

steps.name: delete-component-trigger
steps.comment: Delete the saved component — routes through confirmAction (a re-creatable reusable thing → confirm, no undo). Stash the promise; the confirm modal opens.

steps.name: wait-confirm
steps.failMessage: delete did not open the confirm modal

steps.name: resolve-confirm
steps.comment: Confirm the delete (the same resolution the modal's 'Delete component' button triggers).

steps.name: wait-deleted
steps.failMessage: component was not removed after confirming delete

steps.name: assert-deleted
steps.eval: (function(){ const list = window.__glbDesigner.listUserComponents(); if (list.length !== 0) throw new Error('expected 0 components after delete, got ' + list.length); console.log('9B_DELETE components=' + list.length); })()
